4. Duties of e-commerce entities
(5) Every e-commerce entity shall ensure that the grievance officer referred to
in sub-rule (4) acknowledges the receipt of any consumer complaint within forty-
eight hours and redresses the complaint within one month from the date of receipt
of the complaint.
(9) Every e-commerce entity shall only record the consent of a consumer for
the purchase of any good or service offered on its platform where such consent is
expressed through an explicit and affirmative action, and no such entity shall record
such consent automatically, including in the form of pre-ticked checkboxes.
